{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ghost''' is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning it requires hidden detection for it to be targeted. Additionally, it has the same amount of health as the [[Heavy]] and is significantly faster than it, though it lacks its defense. ==Appearance== The '''Ghost''' is a translucent green-white humanoid that floats slightly above the ground. It wears a tattered long-sleeve shirt that is the same color as its body. It also has a tail instead of legs, which moves as it floated on the path. ==Strategy== *Most early game towers gain hidden detection. Such towers are recommended to deal with early '''Ghosts'''. **As '''Ghosts''' spawn in hordes, the [[Golden Pyromancer]] is particularly useful, being able to damage multiple enemies at once and having hidden detection by default. ***The [[Pyromancer]] can also be useful against '''Ghosts''', although it costs more and does not have hidden detection at base level. **Single target towers, like the [[Golden Crook Boss]] or [[Shotgunner]] can also clear out groups of '''Ghosts''', although they will require more cash to successfully eliminate them. **Though the [[Trapper]] cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, its traps will still work against them. In particular, its landmines can be used to eliminate groups of '''Ghosts''' due to its high splash damage. *For splash damage towers that cannot target '''Ghosts''', such as the [[Mortar]], if a '''Ghosts''' is caught up in an explosion, they will be dealt splash damage. **This means that another detectable enemy must be near the '''Ghost''' for a splash damage tower to hit the '''Ghost'''. **Similarly, the [[Electroshocker]] cannot target the '''Ghost''', however, it can hit it if there are other detectable enemies nearby. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Ghost.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLOGhost.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexGhost.png|'''Ghost''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Interestingly, despite being called a '''Ghost''', it is not a [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] type enemy. ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Ghost''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Ghost''' is difficult to select when trying to do so on its arms. **{{Bug}} '''Ghost''' cannot be hit with [[Gatling Gun]]'s ''FPS'' ability when targeting certain parts of its arm. {{PizzaParty|[[Heavy]]|Wave 5|Ghost|Wave 8|[[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
